title.narrative: Strengthened social dialogue for inclusive and effective policy making

description.narrative:
The ILO will provide technical assistance to the Department of Labour of St Lucia in the creation of a tripartite mechanism for social dialogue between Government and representatives of workers’ and employers’ organizations. Social dialogue institutions are formal arrangement for tripartite collaboration designed to inform and co-produce specific policies to address economic and social challenges.
ILO technical assistance in the establishment of a social dialogue body will consist of organizing workshops aimed at sharing comparative institutional and legal practices, global trends as well as information about the role of the Government (including Secretariat) and social partners in national social dialogue institutions. The ILO will facilitate knowledge-exchange sessions between the tripartite constituents of St Lucia and other social dialogue institutions in the Caribbean such as the C.144 committee of Trinidad and Tobago and the Labour Advisory Board of Grenada. Lastly, the ILO will support the drafting of the Terms of Reference that would formally establish the tripartite mechanism by October 2025.
This programme of work will receive support from the ILO Regional Initiative on Strengthening Social Dialogue and Labour Relations. The Initiative focuses on enhancing collective labour relations across the region through technical assistance aimed at promoting the full application of international labour standards – particularly freedom of association and collective bargaining – and to strengthen mechanisms for social dialogue and the prevention and resolution of labour disputes.
